integrity.novelty_caveat: Classic Pareto/serial-dictatorship equivalence, RSD axioms and the unique-outcome criterion are prior literature, not claimed as novel.
integrity.scope: Complete finite enumeration of matching-level probabilities; not agent-object marginal entries
integrity.verification: Three standalone exact methods, an independent full-domain counter and explicit witness and histogram tables

scientific_limitations: The classification is finite, with exactly four agents, four fully acceptable objects and complete strict preferences.
Numerical frequency claims depend on exhaustive exact-integer code and are not extrapolated to larger markets.
An unindexed earlier frequency table or computational census could duplicate the results.
title: The complete four-agent random-priority matching-lottery spectrum
